title: QA 测试与质量保障关键词

# QA 测试与质量保障关键词

## 概述

本章面向测试与质量保障角色，分为测试类型、缺陷管理、测试策略、质量指标四个部分。它提供测试工作中常用的英语词汇，覆盖从设计用例到跟踪缺陷再到衡量质量的环节。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合测试沟通与缺陷报告。建议把测试类型与缺陷管理术语结合学习，形成对测试流程的完整认识。

## 测试类型

| 词汇                  | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                        |
| --------------------- | ---- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| unit test             | n.   | 单元测试   | write unit tests, unit test coverage            |
| integration test      | n.   | 集成测试   | run integration tests, integration layer        |
| end-to-end test (E2E) | n.   | 端到端测试 | E2E testing, E2E test suite                     |
| regression test       | n.   | 回归测试   | regression suite, prevent regression            |
| smoke test            | n.   | 冒烟测试   | run smoke tests, smoke test passed              |
| stress test           | n.   | 压力测试   | stress test results, stress testing environment |

### 听说例句

> A: Did the smoke test pass on the latest build? B: Yes, all critical paths are green. But we still need to run the full regression suite before release.

> A: Should we add more E2E tests for the checkout flow? B: Definitely. The integration tests alone don't cover the full user journey.

### 写作表达

- A comprehensive regression test suite ensures that new changes do not introduce unintended side effects.
- End-to-end testing simulates real user behavior across the entire application stack.

---

## 缺陷管理

| 词汇       | 词性  | 含义          | 常用搭配                                |
| ---------- | ----- | ------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| bug        | n.    | 缺陷          | report a bug, critical bug              |
| defect     | n.    | 缺陷          | defect tracking, zero-defect            |
| severity   | n.    | 严重程度      | severity level, high severity           |
| reproduce  | v.    | 复现          | reproduce the issue, steps to reproduce |
| triage     | v./n. | 分诊/优先排序 | bug triage, triage meeting              |
| flaky test | n.    | 不稳定测试    | fix flaky tests, flaky test report      |

### 听说例句

> A: Can you reproduce this bug on the staging environment? B: I tried three times. It's intermittent — probably a flaky test interaction.

> A: When is the next bug triage? B: Tomorrow at 2 PM. We have 15 open defects to prioritize by severity.

### 写作表达

- The triage process categorizes defects by severity and assigns them to the appropriate team for resolution.
- Flaky tests undermine confidence in the CI/CD pipeline and should be addressed as a high priority.

---

## 测试策略

| 词汇       | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                              |
| ---------- | ---- | -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| test plan  | n.   | 测试计划 | create a test plan, test plan review  |
| test case  | n.   | 测试用例 | write test cases, test case coverage  |
| edge case  | n.   | 边界情况 | handle edge cases, edge case testing  |
| boundary   | n.   | 边界     | boundary value, boundary testing      |
| coverage   | n.   | 覆盖率   | test coverage, 80% coverage           |
| automation | n.   | 自动化   | test automation, automation framework |

### 听说例句

> A: What's our test coverage for the payment module? B: About 72%. The test plan includes 50 more test cases, mostly for edge cases and boundary values.

> A: Are we investing enough in test automation? B: We should. Manual testing doesn't scale. The automation framework can handle most regression scenarios.

### 写作表达

- The test plan specifies 200 test cases across functional, performance, and security testing categories.
- Investing in test automation reduces manual effort and enables faster feedback during the development cycle.

---

## 质量指标

| 词汇             | 词性 | 含义         | 常用搭配                                   |
| ---------------- | ---- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| pass rate        | n.   | 通过率       | test pass rate, 95% pass rate              |
| defect density   | n.   | 缺陷密度     | low defect density, defect density metric  |
| escape rate      | n.   | 逃逸率       | production escape rate, reduce escape rate |
| SLA              | n.   | 服务等级协议 | meet SLA, SLA compliance                   |
| sign-off         | n.   | 签收/确认    | QA sign-off, get sign-off                  |
| release criteria | n.   | 发版标准     | meet release criteria, release go/no-go    |

### 听说例句

> A: Do we have QA sign-off for this release? B: Not yet. The pass rate is 97%, but we have two open P1 defects that don't meet the release criteria.

> A: What's our production escape rate this quarter? B: 0.5%, which is within our SLA target. Defect density has also decreased by 15%.

### 写作表达

- QA sign-off requires a minimum test pass rate of 98% and zero open P0/P1 defects.
- The team achieved a production escape rate of 0.3%, reflecting significant improvements in pre-release quality assurance.
